verdict.rationale: Galileo ships an official MCP server (docs-31, docs-4, probe-4) that lets an agent create/manage datasets, run experiments, and set up prompt templates from the dev environment, and Galileo captures traces/spans/metrics via its logging SDK (docs-6, docs-7). However, the documented MCP capability list does not explicitly include querying existing traces, metrics, or eval results for debugging, and no public API/OpenAPI spec was discoverable (galileo-probe-3 returned 404s on all candidate paths). missing for 10: explicit MCP/API endpoints for reading back traces/metrics/eval results, a documented query interface for debugging via agent, discoverable OpenAPI/API reference.
